text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—...Yeah.
With each passing day, my body feels lighter.
choice_data_list: After a short break, let's move on to the next routine.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you.
I guided Rose Kingdom into the shade of the trees and handed her a towel and drink. Glancing down at my tablet to check the training menu—
A certain piece of news caught my eye.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
“Eishin Flash withdraws from the Kikuka Sho at the eleventh hour.
Stated cause: accumulated muscular fatigue dating back to the Japanese Derby.”
——

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: “A decision made with sights set on running in the Japan Cup and Arima Kinen”—I see. That makes sense.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It cannot be helped.
If anything, I am glad it was a forward-looking decision.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Still, in the end,
it appears I am the only one running in the Kikuka Sho.
Following the Japanese Derby, official announcements had been made that Victoire Pisa and Rulership would pursue different racing schedules.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Come autumn, I shall embark on a campaign to France.
I wish to expand a new circle of hope across the sea.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I shall return to Japan
in time for the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
As I said before,
gauging by my aptitudes, 3,000 meters is off the board.
In other words, this is a strategic rest.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
With the winter clash of titans ahead,
I can hardly afford to exhaust myself here.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...It would be a lie to say I have no regrets.
Yet, that is precisely why—I cannot allow myself to run half-heartedly.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
If I, who have been counted among them, were to show weakness,
it would drag their names through the mud.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Break is over.
Let us resume, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaaaaaaah—!!
And then came the day of the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: "The headliners of what was heralded as the 'strongest generation' are all absent from this Kikuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
“Among them, all eyes are on Rose Kingdom.
Her stellar performance throughout the Classic campaign
has become the talk of the racing world—”

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly, it's a shame Flash isn't here.
Well, I'm sure Rose will put on a brilliant race for us regardless!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: “I suspect the distance might be a bit too long for Rose. If I recall correctly, many from the Rosen Clan tended to struggle at longer distances.”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Naturally... the absence of everyone
has affected the enthusiasm in the stands as well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Is the name of Rose Kingdom—of the Rose Clan alone—
not enough to kindle their expectations?
choice_data_list: After all, we are still only halfway along our path.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Rather, I suppose it all comes down to today's performance.
(—*Knock, knock!*)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. Rose-san,
Trainer <username>-san.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Pisa...! Ruler, Flash-senpai—
Whatever is the matter?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Pisa-san was kind enough to extend an invitation.
I had dearly wanted to come cheer for you as well, so I gladly accompanied her.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
To be frank, this visit is partly an inspection.
Show me that you can seize the crown and stride boldly into winter.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
We are all praying that this will be
a magnificent race for you, Rose-san.

text_block_list.name: Pisa & Ruler & Flash
text_block_list.text:
"'—We're cheering for you, Rose-san!'
'—Don't put too much pressure on yourself, Your Majesty.'
'—Do your best, Rose-san!'"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (... I see. Everyone went out of their way to come—and Pisa has only just returned from France.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...—I am grateful for your consideration.
Then by all means, bear witness.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I shall engrave this name upon the turf of this racecourse. As the vanguard of my house, and—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: As the representative of our generation.
